specimen_type.description: Specimen type (e.g. wedge gastrectomy, small bowel resection, colectomy).

site_of_tumour.description: Site of tumour (e.g. stomach, duodenum, jejunum/ileum, rectum).

maximum_tumour_dimension_cm.description: Maximum tumour dimension in cm (e.g. 3, 3.2). If given in mm, convert to cm.

distance_to_nearest_longitudinal_margin_.description: Distance of tumour to nearest longitudinal resection margin in cm (blank if not provided).

distance_to_closest_circumferential_marg.description: Distance of tumour to closest circumferential resection margin in cm (blank if not provided).

block_for_molecular_or_trial_use.description: Block(s) for molecular or clinical trial use (blank if not provided).

treatment_response_features.description: Features indicating a response to treatment.

afip_risk_category.description:
AFIP/Lasota–Miettinen risk category. Compute STRICTLY from tumour site, maximum size (cm) and mitotic count per 5 mm2.
Bins:
Mitotic ≤5 and size ≤2: None (all sites)
Mitotic ≤5 and size >2–≤5: Gastric Very low; Duodenum Low; Jejunum/Ileum Low; Rectum Low
Mitotic ≤5 and size >5–≤10: Gastric Low; Jejunum/Ileum Moderate; Duodenum Not appropriate; Rectum Not appropriate
Mitotic ≤5 and size >10: Gastric Moderate; Duodenum High; Jejunum/Ileum High; Rectum High
Mitotic >5 and size ≤2: Rectum High; Gastric Not appropriate; Duodenum Not appropriate; Jejunum/Ileum Not appropriate
Mitotic >5 and size >2–≤5: Gastric Moderate; Duodenum High; Jejunum/Ileum High; Rectum High
Mitotic >5 and size >5–≤10: Gastric High; Jejunum/Ileum High; Duodenum Not appropriate; Rectum Not appropriate
Mitotic >5 and size >10: Gastric High; Duodenum High; Jejunum/Ileum High; Rectum High
If any of size/mitoses/site missing, return Not appropriate.

tnm_pT.description: TNM pT for GIST based on SIZE ONLY: T1 ≤2 cm; T2 >2–≤5 cm; T3 >5–≤10 cm; T4 >10 cm. If size missing, TX.

tnm_pN.description: TNM pN: N1 if lymph_nodes_positive > 0 else N0 (NX only if explicitly stated unknown).

tnm_pM.description: TNM pM: use M1 if peritoneal_metastasis or liver_metastasis or other_metastasis is Present.

tnm_pM_display.description: Display: 'M1' if tnmpM is M1, else 'Not applicable'.
